mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening manufacturing sector, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (p < 0.05) in periods when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month MA compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals a weakening housing market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and construction sector earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (p < 0.05) in periods when HOUST falls below its 12-month MA compared to baseline.
